description:
Award an award-mode drop to a wallet (the user reached a milestone). The drop's caps and window are enforced. Store key scope: rewards:award.

Params: store_id, drop_id, wallet, session_token?, idempotency_key? (use one per milestone so a retry never awards twice)
Returns: {ok, idempotency_key, …award result}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_404, HTTP_409 (cap reached / drop not active)

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_award
title: Award a drop
